name: XR Animator v0.37.0 (free webcam full-body mocap app)
summary: Free AI motion-capture app: full-body, face (52 ARKit blendshapes) and hand tracking from a single webcam or video, driving any VRM/MMD avatar. Records and exports motion to VMD/BVH/glTF, sends VMC protocol to VSeeFace/VNyan/Warudo. v0.37.0 public release adds lip sync from audio input and camera/leg-animation fixes. Runs in the browser or as a Windows/Linux/macOS/Android app.

access.price: $0; patrons get early access ~9 months ahead
access.notes: README: CC BY-NC-SA applies to adapting the source code; it does not apply to content you generate (e.g. mocap videos/motions with your own assets), over which XR Animator claims no rights. Bundled third-party assets keep their own licenses.

procedure: Try it in the browser at sao.animetheme.com/XR_Animator.html, or
Open GitHub Releases for XR-Animator_v0.37.0 and download the zip for Windows, Linux, macOS (ARM64/x64 beta) or Android
Unzip and run, load a VRM/MMD avatar and enable webcam full-body tracking
Record and export motion as BVH/VMD/glTF, or stream via VMC protocol

verdict.why: Verified: release page and Windows zip resolve, web app 200, license section read in README. Mature free webcam mocap (2k GitHub stars) with BVH export useful for indie animation; source is non-commercial but generated content is unrestricted.
